info.title: KeyForge dependent-app API
info.description: Current product-scoped API. Tokens are two base64url segments (not JWTs); Ed25519 signs the decoded UTF-8 JSON bytes. License v4 and trial v2 payloads are documented in components. Import policy opt-in adds license v5, trial v3 and separate usage-recovery v1; legacy v4/v2 remain supported. Full contextual, time and status checks are required. Private/admin routes are deliberately excluded.

servers.description: Replace with your KeyForge deployment URL

get.description: Unsigned liveness and supported token versions, not a build identifier or authorization grant.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

get.description: Public deployment branding and runtime metadata. This unsigned response does not grant application features.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

get.description: Discovery only. Trust must be established through the application's pinned update channel, never by automatically trusting this response.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Online registration pins a client-generated random 256-bit base64url bearer credential. Persist the credential, body and requestId before sending; replay exactly after interruption. machineSignals are optional hashed hints, not proof of identity. A returned trial must be explicitly selected and verified; registration alone need not enable trial use.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Online inspection only; consumes no seat and does not return an offline grant.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Online activation binds an installation seat and returns a signed v4 token. Repeating the same key/identity reuses the binding. Verify and atomically persist the grant before enabling features.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Requires an existing binding. HTTP 200 may contain a signed revoked or expired license. Verify and persist negative grants; do not retain old authorization after a verified denial.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Online seat release. Clear local authorization after success; no offline seat release is supported.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

put.description: Authenticated recognition-only backfill. Does not register again, merge groups, change trial counters, consume seats or reset usage. Reports hashes only; empty signals preserve historical recognition evidence while current availability becomes unavailable.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Installation-authenticated request only; never grants recovery without independent admin approval. Persist UUID/challenge before networking, reuse exact body. Send only an optional nonce-bound usage commitment, not usage history.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Claims an approved, unexpired recovery once on the server. Exact retries are safe while the generation remains current. Verify the separate recovery signature, challenge, account, generation and candidate commitment before atomically adopting it with the v5 license. Approval expires after 24 hours.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

get.description: Poll while online with backoff; only this installation's public replies, expiration notices and license deliveries are returned. No email or realtime transport.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

put.description: Installation-specific preferences. License deliveries are always shown.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Mark an event read for this installation only.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Retrieve a delivered key for its targeted installation; repeatable. Collection does not activate a license or consume a seat. Never log the returned key.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

get.description: Returns this installation's cases and public messages. Currently unpaginated; no internal notes or operator assignments.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Requires a license binding. Technical/feature/other categories require an active binding; licensing/billing also work with an existing expired/released binding. Trimmed subject is 3–120 characters and message 10–5000. Persist the exact request and UUID before sending; Idempotency-Key must equal requestId.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

get.description: Retrieve a public thread including revision for replies. Operator authors are presented as support.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Persist requestId/body across retries. Use the current revision; on revision_conflict retrieve the thread before asking the user to retry. Exact replay returns the existing message even with an old revision. Resolved cases reopen; closed cases require a new case. Customers cannot write internal notes.

default.description: Failure; inspect error and retryable. Never treat an error as a grant.

post.description: Separate preinstallation credential: random 256-bit base64url secret, not an installation or admin credential. Exact id/body/secret replay is supported. The public status page keeps this secret in the URL fragment, never a query string.

post.description: Private-secret retrieval after operator approval. Returned key is activated through the installation API later; pending requests return request_pending.

machineSignals.description: Legacy registration accepts any JSON and normalizes recognized kind/lowercase SHA-256 pairs, dropping invalid entries and duplicate pairs. Recommended clients send at most three typed signals; unlike backfill this route does not enforce that count.

InstallationCredential.description: Client-generated per-installation secret pinned at registration; not the product/license key.

RequestCredential.description: Private preinstallation request secret; separate from installation credentials.

ServiceCredential.description: Trusted-backend product-scoped usage credential with usage:read/usage:consume permissions.
